name: CDAO Token
exploit_detail: ~$52K, ~167,200 Pro tokens lost. The Pro token contract of Crypto DAO was exploited via missing access control on publicly callable vault functions. CDAO's only qualifying pool is CDAO/Pro (Pro=0x8D65744527f55d0b2338350912d5C99A81ddF0e2), so the exploited contract is this token's paired asset, not the CDAO token itself.

name: SWAN TREASURY
exploit_detail: ~$625K. Off-chain signer key hardcoded as _signer in the ZhaiquanBuy contract was leaked; attacker forged signatures to buy ~687k STY at a 100x discount via a PancakeSwap flash loan and exited through the STY/USDT pool. Key compromise, not a signature-verification bug. Vulnerable code sits in ZhaiquanBuy, NOT in the STY token.

PIZZA
exploit_detail: SlowMist lists a 2021 PIZZA exploit on eCurve. This deployment is an EIP-1167 clone of the 2026 launchpad implementation 0x024f1829..., shared with 19 other tokens in this set, so it is not the 2021 contract.

name: GPU
exploit_detail: SlowMist lists a 2024 GPU exploit on BNB Chain (_transfer self-transfer balance bug). Could not confirm whether this is the same deployment: getcontractcreation is blocked on this API key and public RPCs are pruned, so historical eth_getCode fails. Contract shape differs (launchpad clone with init/setMode). Treat as unconfirmed.
